title: The Bridge That Fell For a Song

story_beat.hook: Frame 0-15: The hook - introducing the bridge and the 74 soldiers marching in step
story_beat.setup: Frame 15-40: Setup - showing the bridge, the soldiers, the river, the town below
story_beat.build_1: Frame 40-70: First build - soldiers marching, increasing tempo, the bridge beginning to creak
story_beat.snap_1: Frame 70-85: First snap - initial creak, first soldiers lose footing
story_beat.build_2: Frame 85-110: Second build - tempo increases, more soldiers join, the bridge begins to sway
story_beat.snap_2: Frame 110-125: Second snap - harder creak, more soldiers falling, the bridge deck tilting
story_beat.build_3: Frame 125-150: Third build - maximum tempo, all soldiers marching, the bridge visibly shaking
story_beat.snap_3: Frame 150-170: Third snap - the breaking point, the bridge beginning to collapse
story_beat.deadpan: Frame 170-185: The deadpan moment - silence after the collapse, the aftermath
story_beat.explanation: Frame 185-210: The explanation - why the bridge fell, the physics of resonance
story_beat.conclusion: Frame 210-235: The conclusion - the new rule, the lesson learned

shot_types.wide: Establishing shots of the bridge and scene
shot_types.medium: Medium shots of soldiers and action
shot_types.closeup: Closeups of key moments and details
shot_types.aerial: Aerial shots showing the full bridge and river
